$comment: claude-mini config schema (ADR-0031 §4). A deliberately small typed subset, not JSON Schema: node types object|string|int|bool|array|enum; object nodes list 'properties' and 'required'; array nodes give 'items' and optional 'min_items'; string nodes may give 'pattern' (Python regex, whole value); enum nodes give 'values'. Unknown keys are rejected. Validated by plugin/bin/config.

base_branch.doc: Branch reviews and diffs compare against.

types.doc: Allowed Conventional Commits types; plain words, matched literally.

scope_pattern.doc: ERE for the optional (scope), without parentheses.

skip_prefixes.doc: Subjects starting with these are not checked (git autosquash markers).

version.doc: Pinned npm version run via npx; never installed globally.

language.doc: Language for reports shown to the user, e.g. en, ru.

checklist.doc: Deployment checklist read by setup/harness (ADR-0031 §2). An override replaces the whole items list.

handler.doc: Typed handler implemented in setup/harness; no shell strings.

binary.doc: binary-version: program looked up on PATH, asked for --version.

patterns.doc: git-exclude: lines that must be in the project's .git/info/exclude.

tool.doc: auth-status: whose login status is checked.

packages.doc: System package per manager. Installed only when the item id is named in --allow-system.

applies_if.doc: Config key that must be true for the item to apply.

optional.doc: When not ready, the harness runs in reduced mode instead of failing.

manual.doc: What a person does when there is no package for this OS. Shown, never executed.

purpose.doc: What the harness loses without this item.

run_dir.doc: Project-relative directory for harness state, reports and backups.
